gaps.detail: Mock unit 3 'Calculus: Limits, Continuity & Differentiability' holds 50 questions over 4 subtopics (indeterminate-forms-lhopital 14, continuity-analysis 12, mean-value-theorems 12, partial-derivatives 12) and no notes card exists for any of them; the notes repo covers discrete mathematics only.
Lesson topics/cpu-scheduling (PUBLISHED 2026-10-27, 26 microtopics from FCFS/SJF/SRTF/round robin to MLFQ) serves no notes card; the notes repo has no operating-systems subject yet.

14 combinatorics cards carry no mock unit: the discrete-mathematics bank has units 1-6 and 16 (propositional-logic, predicate-logic, set-theory, relations, functions, induction-recursion, proof-techniques) and none covers counting.
No published lesson covers Stirling numbers of the second kind or integer partitions; counting-and-combinatorics stops at stars and bars, inclusion-exclusion, surjections and derangements.
